messages:
elaine: Morning folks — small ask: can people pick up docs PRs for the sprint? I put a shortlist here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pulls?q=is%3Aopen+label%3Adocs+sort%3Aupdated-desc

ben: happy to take a couple link fixes and the tiny CLI snippet update

morgan: @elaine I can take the Python SDK snippets and the migration guide examples. Prefer pairing on the migration one, it's a bit messy.

elaine: amazing — Python + migration pairing noted. For timing, let's aim to merge any docs PRs during Wed-Thu merge window. CI/docs-preview needs to be green before merging.

samir: I can do the CI preview checks and merge once green. Please ping me with the PR link. I'll wait for a green linkcheck + preview deploy.

ci-bot: docs-preview build started for branch feat/snippet-cleanup — check: https://deploy-preview.example.com/432

ben: Question — how are we handling reviewer assignment for examples? We have some PRs with label `needs-review` but no +1

elaine: good point. Let's do this: assign primary reviewer + backup. Primary merges if green; backup steps in if primary unavailable within 24h. document this in the PR body as `Reviewer` and `Backup`.

jules: I'll be backup for Rust snippets and can review Go examples next sprint.

morgan: @samir will ping you two PRs: #431 (python snippets) and #433 (migration guide). I want to pair on #433 for ~30m before final edits.

samir: ack — ping me when preview link is up. I'll watch linkcheck failures (those are the usual blocker).

ci-bot: build finished: linkcheck failed on /guides/migration#step-2 — 1 broken link

ben: I'll take that broken link fix now — should be quick.

elaine: timeline check — if we fix linkcheck and preview is green by Thu 12:00 PST we can include these in the Thu deploy batch. Otherwise they go next sprint. :thumbsup:

morgan: understood. I'll open PR comment with Reviewer: morgan; Backup: samir and request pairing slot.

ben: fixed link, pushed to #430 — re-running preview

ci-bot: deploy preview started for PR #430 — https://deploy-preview.example.com/430

samir: saw the preview and it's good. I'll merge once CI hits all green. Thanks team!

elaine: thanks everyone — summary: morgan primary for Python + migration (pairing on migration), ben link fixes, jules backup for Rust, samir doing CI+merge. I'll add a short note to the docs-ops checklist about primary/backup labels.

ben: :rocket:

morgan: thx!
